editorialRules: Never assign ICT primary-source provenance without a direct primary-source reference.
Separate PLAYBOOK SOURCE, ICT PRIMARY SOURCE, COMMUNITY CONVENTION and SUPPLEMENTAL.
Video search links must be labelled discovery links; direct videos must be checked for title, channel and content match.
Each public lesson must include learning purpose, identification criteria, examples, limitations and sources.
Builder private API keys and personal access tokens must never be included in browser content.
